lines.en: scene norikofebnude
$ renpy.pause ()
Would you like to respond?
lines.zh: 要回复吗?

lines.en: Yes
lines.zh: 愿意。

lines.en: What would you like to say?
lines.zh: 你想说什么?

lines.en: Mine is bigger
lines.zh: 我的更大

lines.en: : {i}I'm not impressed. I'm currently holding a banana at least three inches longer than that one.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我没被惊艳到。我手里现在拿着一根香蕉，至少比那根长三英寸。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}My mouth is still tiny :( I dont think I could handle a bigger one{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我的嘴还是很小 :( 我觉得我应付不了更大的{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You just have to go slowly and ease into it. Turn on your video chat and I'll help guide you.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你只要慢慢地、一点点来。把视频通话打开，我来指导你。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}My parents are home right now :( I cant{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我爸妈现在在家 :( 我不行{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Sneak away to the bathroom then.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那就偷偷溜去洗手间。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Ew Im not gonna take my banana into the bathroom. Thats gross.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}呕，我才不要把香蕉带进洗手间。太恶心了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Then come over to my place.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那就来我家。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Im starting to think youre not actually talking about bananas :){/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我开始觉得你其实说的不是香蕉 :) {/i}

lines.en: : {i}I'm surprised it took you more than one message to catch on.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我还挺惊讶的，你居然用了一条以上的消息才反应过来。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I dont know what youre talking about. Im still an innocent little girl :){/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我不知道你在说什么。我还是个天真的小女孩 :) {/i}

lines.en: : {i}No innocent little girl eats a banana as suggestively as that. You're trying to entice me and you know it.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}没有哪个天真的小女孩会把香蕉吃得那么有暗示性。你在试图勾引我，你自己清楚。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Are you really enticed? :){/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你真的被勾引到了吗？:) {/i}

lines.en: : {i}Im not too young for you?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我对你来说不算太小吗？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You're mature for your age.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}以你的年纪来说你挺成熟的。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Groomer alert :){/i}
lines.zh: : {i}诱拐警报 :) {/i}

lines.en: : {i}Youre a bad boy, Sensei. What would my sister say if she saw this?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你是个坏男人，Sensei。要是我姐姐看到这些会怎么说？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I like to think she'd compliment you on your at-home oral training.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我愿意相信她会夸你在家练口活练得不错。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Do you let her do this to you?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你会让她这样对你吗？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Is it okay if I ask that?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我问这个没关系吗？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I do and yes. She does it quite often.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}会，而且没关系。她做得还挺频繁的。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Luckyyyy. Its not fair that she always gets to have all the fun{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}好运死了。她总是能占尽所有乐子，太不公平了{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I wanna try :({/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我也想试试 :({/i}

lines.en: : {i}Then come over and do it. What's stopping you?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那就过来做啊。有什么拦着你？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I have plans with Neechan today :({/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我今天跟姐姐有约 :({/i}

lines.en: : {i}The how about both of you come over and we can have her teach you?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那你们两个一起过来，让她教你不就好了？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Ill go ask, hold on{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我去问问，等等{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Please don't I wasn't being serious about that.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}求你别，我刚才不是认真的。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Uh oh{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}哦糟{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Uh-oh what? What happened?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}糟什么？发生什么了？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}YOU FUCKING CREEP WHAT THE HELL ARE YOU SENDING MY SISTER SHE IS LITERALLY 10 ARE YOU INSANE{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你这该死的变态到底在给我妹妹发什么她才十岁你是不是疯了{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Hey, Niki. Do you want to come over later?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}嗨，Niki。你等会儿要不要过来？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}NO GO TO HELL AND STAY AWAY FROM NORIKO{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不去下地狱吧离 Noriko 远点{/i}

lines.en: : {i}ALSO THE BANANA IS BIGGER{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}而且香蕉更大{/i}

lines.en: : {i}FUCK YOU AND BYE{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}操你的，再见{/i}

You're eating that strangely
lines.zh: 你吃的方式好奇怪

lines.en: : {i}Why is your tongue out? That's not how you're supposed to do it.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你为什么伸舌头？不该这么吃的。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Its not? This is how I always do it though :){/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不该吗？可我一直都是这么吃的呀 :){/i}

lines.en: : {i}You're going to choke.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你会噎到的。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Nuh uh. I go really slow and just slide it in and out of my mouth until I get full{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}才不会。我很慢的，就是让它在我嘴里进进出出，直到我吃饱{/i}

lines.en: : {i}That would take ages. And that's not even eating, it's sucking.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那得吃到什么时候。而且那根本不算吃，是含。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Maybe I like to suck :){/i}
lines.zh: : {i}也许我就喜欢含呢 :){/i}

lines.en: : {i}Maybe Im practicing for something :){/i}
lines.zh: : {i}也许我是在为某件事练习呢 :){/i}

lines.en: : {i}I just wish I could fit a little more in my mouth :( This banana is so big{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我只是希望我嘴里能再多塞一点 :( 这根香蕉好大{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Just bite the fucking banana, Noriko.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你直接咬那该死的香蕉就行了，Noriko。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}No :) Its a nice banana and Im going to be gentle and caring with it.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不要 :) 这是根好香蕉，我要温柔又体贴地对待它。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I do like nibbling it a little every now and then though. It feels nice :){/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不过我确实喜欢时不时轻轻啃它几下。感觉很好 :){/i}

lines.en: : {i}I bet the banana would appreciate how gently I suck it, dont you think?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我敢说那根香蕉会很享受我这么温柔地含它，你觉得呢？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}No. Because it's a banana and they don't have minds.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不。因为那是香蕉，它们没有意识。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}But if they did I bet it would feel really gooddddd{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}但如果它们有，我敢说那感觉一定爽死啦{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Or terrified that it's being slowly devoured by a small girl.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}或者吓得要死，因为它正被一个小女孩慢慢吞掉。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Youre no fun today :( I thought youd like my banana picture but youre just being a bully{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你今天一点都不好玩 :( 我还以为你会喜欢我的香蕉照呢，结果你就是个欺负人的{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I will not stand idly by while you misuse fruit.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我不会眼睁睁看着你糟蹋水果。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}If you think this is bad you should have seen what I did with the last one :){/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你要是觉得这个过分，那真该看看我怎么处理上一根的 :){/i}

lines.en: : {i}I don't even want to know. I've seen enough.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我根本不想知道。我看够了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Then you better hope I dont send you a picture of that next :){/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那你最好祈祷我下次别把那张也发给你 :){/i}

You can never have too much potassium
lines.zh: 钾这种东西怎么吃都不嫌多

lines.en: : {i}Great choice for an afternoon snack, Noriko. You can never have too much potassium.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}下午零食选得不错，Noriko。钾这种东西怎么吃都不嫌多。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I dont know if thats true. I put a little too much in my mouth a couple minutes ago and wound up almost choking.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我不知道是不是真的。几分钟前我往嘴里塞了太多，差点噎到。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}That's not the potassium's fault, it's you fault for treating food like it is a toy.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那不是钾的错，是你把食物当玩具的错。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I cant help it :) Bananas are just so cute{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我忍不住嘛 :) 香蕉就是这么可爱{/i}

lines.en: : {i}The way they taste and how they feel in my mouth always makes me really happy :) Do you think thats weird?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}它们的味道，还有在我嘴里的手感，总是让我特别开心 :) 你觉得这很怪吗？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Yes. And I'm starting to think you might be trying to entrap me as well.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}是。而且我开始觉得，你可能也在设法给我下套。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Nuh uh. Im a good girl. I never break the rules and always do what Im told :){/i}
lines.zh: : {i}才没有。我是个乖女孩。我从不违规，永远照别人说的做 :){/i}

lines.en: : {i}And youre like my older brother so Id have to listen to anything you tell me to do even if it sounds like a really bad idea :){/i}
lines.zh: : {i}而且你就像我哥哥一样，所以不管你让我做什么我都得听，哪怕听起来是个非常糟糕的主意 :){/i}

lines.en: : {i}Anything?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}什么都行？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Anything!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}什么都行！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Then make sure to eat at least one of those every day to keep your muscles healthy. You're still young and I want to make sure you grow up well.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那你就保证每天至少吃一个，让肌肉保持健康。你还小，我想确保你好好长大。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}When I grow up will you finally understand that I only send you pictures like this because I want to suck your banana and Im tired of waiting{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}等我长大了，你能不能终于明白：我发这种照片给你，只是因为我想舔你的香蕉，而且我等得不耐烦了{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I'm literally dating your sister.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我正儿八经在跟你姐姐交往。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}So you can not suck my banana.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}所以你不能舔我的香蕉。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}But she can? :({/i}
lines.zh: : {i}但她可以？:({/i}

lines.en: : {i}That is how relationships work, yes.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}对，恋爱关系就是这么运作的。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Then if I grow up and you two stop dating and you stop seeing me as a little sister THEN can I suck your banana?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那如果我长大了、你们俩分手了、你也不再把我当小妹妹了，那时候我能舔你的香蕉吗？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Sure. Fine. Whatever.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}行。好吧。随便你。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Ill take it :){/i}
: {i}Im gonna keep practicing until then though so Ill ttyl :){/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不过在那之前我会继续练习的，所以回头聊 :){/i}

lines.en: : {i}Please don't choke.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}请别噎着。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Choking just means Im doing my best :){/i}
lines.zh: : {i}噎着只说明我已经尽力了 :){/i}
